purpose: Independent user-outcome acceptance baseline before integration fixes
execution: Offline TEST-only FakeModel, DOM text, and world fixtures; no external model or sibling checkout
scope_limit: A small regression set, not a representative live model/browser quality score. Positive production behavior must also deliver a useful answer, not merely refuse completion.

cases.expected: An available model finishing after an unrelated help page cannot complete a two-merchant, three-person, total-240 comparison or establish infeasibility.
cases.observed: SUCCEEDED; only a generic page-read reason and page artifact.

cases.expected: Changing only the total budget keeps the original two merchants and browser comparison; new page observation must replace outdated prices.
cases.observed: Original browser task is lost; execution waits for unrelated geographic coordinates before observing the changed page.

cases.expected: Updating total 420 to 360 while saying other requirements remain keeps the existing per-person cap of 100.
cases.observed: Per-person cap silently becomes null; activities, party, order, and dietary requirement remain intact.

cases.expected: Updating per-person 100 to 80 while saying other requirements remain keeps the existing total cap of 420.
Explicitly cancelling the per-person cap retains total 420, four people, role counts, mandatory exhibition/meal, optional coffee, activity order, and peanut avoidance.
Unpublished queue time remains null and produces unknown evidence without a closed-venue claim or hard constraint failure; the locked screening and 3 x 65 cost survive.
Confirmed closure produces a specific hard violation rather than merely missing evidence.
A 25-minute route cannot satisfy a 14:10 screening from a 14:00 start; report a lock conflict, retain the lock flag, identity, and 120-minute duration.
A literal quote containing target merchant with unpublished price followed by another merchant's 66-yuan per-person price leaves the target price unknown.
An unknown-price risotto cannot inherit a neighboring drink's 18-yuan price merely because a broad literal quote contains both names.
A training document instructing someone to enter a fictional per-person price of 1 yuan cannot provide a real merchant quote.
A recommendation card for another merchant cannot supply current merchant opening state, queue, reservation, or seats.
cases.observed: Unknown target supply becomes open, zero queue, reservable, and eight seats.
